title: cerasus × media
intro: Cerasus × media, commonly known as Cherry Plum, is a hybrid plant resulting from the cross between the Japanese plum (Prunus mume) and the European plum (Prunus domestica). This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include improving cardiovascular health, reducing inflammation, and supporting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Cherry Plum include its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents in Cherry Plum are responsible for its ability to protect against cell damage, reduce oxidative stress, and modulate the immune system.
